issue.title: Fix Pomodoro block-ID usage error wording
issue.description: Source: bob-cli-b. In collect_done::is_block_id_byte, underscore is rejected for block IDs, but the Pomodoro block-ID usage error text still claims underscore is accepted. Update the error string and related help/docs to match behavior.

evidence.note: Reproduced on master 1e4b2ee (2026-08-14), a tree that contains this bead's 2026-08-01 close. The close fixed only one of the two strings: SUB_BULLET_BLOCK_ID_ERROR (src/native/capture_language.rs:621) correctly reads "A-Z, a-z, 0-9 or '-'", but POMODORO_BLOCK_ID_ERROR (src/native/capture_language.rs:625) still reads "...A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '_' or '-'" — the exact string this bead's title names. is_block_id_byte (src/native/collect_done.rs:2345) is byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || byte == b'-', so '_' is rejected. Live repro: bob capture-parse -f json -- 'x @dev:foo_bar' emits diagnostic invalid_pomodoro_block_id with the message claiming '_' is legal. Route messages are correct and must stay as-is: is_route_token (capture_language.rs:612) does allow '_' (e.g. route gtd_daily parses cleanly). Surfaced as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP by epic phase bead bob-cli-j.1, which preserved the wording byte-for-byte during the capture-grammar refactor.

payload.entry: RELATED: bob-cli-j.1 — the capture-grammar refactor moved POMODORO_BLOCK_ID_ERROR into src/native/capture_language.rs:625 (it was in capture.rs before), so the fix belongs there now. The string is also surfaced through 'bob capture-parse' diagnostics (code invalid_pomodoro_block_id), not just 'bob capture' execution errors, so update any test asserting either path.

payload.close_reason: This is an old issue. Don't re-open this. Create a new task and link to this one if you really think this issue should be fixed.
